speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old girl. The patient was brought to the emergency department because of a 2-day history of low-grade fever, itchy rash, and generalized joint pain. The rash initially started in the antecubital and popliteal fossae before spreading to the trunk and distal extremities. speaker: Doctor
text:

On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the severity of the itching, and have you noticed any swelling of your lips, tongue, or difficulty breathing?
